title: The Zygmund conjecture and Rey's exponential integrability conjecture
summary: We prove the Zygmund conjecture in all parameters: the maximal operator associated with products of cubes with side lengths $(s_1,\ldots,s_{m-1},φ(s_1,\ldots,s_{m-1}))$, where $φ$ is any positive coordinatewise nondecreasing function, satisfies the weak $L(\log L)^{m-2}$ estimate for every $m\geq3$. The estimate is new for $m>3$. Our approach is to prove Rey's recent conjecture on the exponential integrability of the overlap function $h_{\mathcal G}=\sum_{I\in\mathcal G}\mathbf{1}_I$, with exponent $1/(m-1)$, for sparse incomparable families $\mathcal G$ of $m$-parameter dyadic rectangles,…
